64238-the-flight-of-the-eagle.title: The Flight Of The Eagle
64238-the-flight-of-the-eagle.creator: Unknown
64238-the-flight-of-the-eagle.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Well, I know, and for once I'd like to have someone stand still long enough so I could tell the story. The minute anyone sees an old spaceman like me coming, they jet the hell out of there fast. "Old Captain Morley's got another shaggy dog to comb out!" they say, and beat it. My stories, it seems, are too old fashioned for this modern age.

arxiv-2012-03683.title: A New Framework for Registration of Semantic Point Clouds from Stereo and RGB-D Cameras Thanks: *Toyota Research Institute (TRI) provided funds to support this work. Thanks: R. Zhang, T.Y. Lin, C.E. Lin, J. Grizzle, R. Eustice, and M. Ghaffari are with the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, MI 48109
arxiv-2012-03683.creator: Ray Zhang, Tzu-Yuan Lin, Chien Erh Lin, Steven A. Parkison, William Clark, Jessy W. Grizzle
arxiv-2012-03683.description: Abstract This paper reports on a novel nonparametric rigid point cloud registration framework that jointly integrates geometric and semantic measurements such as color or semantic labels into the alignment process and does not require explicit data association. The point clouds are represented as nonparametric functions in a reproducible kernel Hilbert space.

arxiv-2202-01345.title: Fluctuation scaling limits for positive recurrent jumping-in diffusions with large jumps
arxiv-2202-01345.description: Abstract For positive recurrent jumping-in diffusions with large jumps, we study scaling limits of the fluctuations of inverse local times and occupation times. We generalize the eigenfunctions with modified Neumann boundary condition, which have been introduced in the previous study for small jumps, to a class of diffusions of stronger singularity.

arxiv-2203-03434.title: Large- S S and tensor-network methods for strongly-interacting topological insulators
arxiv-2203-03434.creator: E. Tirrito, S. Hands, A. Bermudez
arxiv-2203-03434.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by E. Tirrito, S. Hands, A. Bermudez. The study of correlation effects in topological phases of matter can benefit from a multidisciplinary approach that combines techniques drawn from condensed matter, high-energy physics and quantum information science. In this work, we exploit these connections to study the strongly-interacting limit of certain lattice Hubbard models of topological insulators, which map onto four-Fermi quantum field theories with a Wilson-type discretization, and have been recently shown to be at reach of cold-atom quantum simulators based on synthetic spin-orbit coupling.

arxiv-2207-05168.title: Swift chiral quantum walks
arxiv-2207-05168.creator: Massimo Frigerio 1,2 , Matteo G. A. Paris 1,2
arxiv-2207-05168.description: Abstract A continuous-time quantum walk (CTQW) is sedentary if the return probability in the starting vertex is close to one at all times. Recent results imply that, when starting from a maximal degree vertex, the CTQW dynamics generated by the Laplacian and adjacency matrices are typically sedentary.

arxiv-2306-07706.title: Towards Explainable TOPSIS: Visual Insights into the Effects of Weights and Aggregations on Rankings Journal: Applied Soft Computing
arxiv-2306-07706.creator: Robert Susmaga, Izabela Szczęch, Dariusz Brzezinski
arxiv-2306-07706.description: Abstract Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) is extensively used across diverse industries to assess and rank alternatives. Among numerous MCDA methods developed to solve real-world ranking problems, TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution) remains one of the most popular choices in many application areas.

arxiv-2306-15820.title: Polyhedra with hexagonal and triangular faces and three faces around each vertex
arxiv-2306-15820.creator: Linda Green, Stellen Li
arxiv-2306-15820.description: Abstract We analyze polyhedra composed of hexagons and triangles with three faces around each vertex, and their 3-regular planar graphs of edges and vertices, which we call “trihexes”. Trihexes are analogous to fullerenes, which are 3-regular planar graphs whose faces are all hexagons and pentagons.

arxiv-2407-11178.title: Spacetime with prescribed hidden symmetry
arxiv-2407-11178.creator: Song He, Yi Li
arxiv-2407-11178.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate spacetime characterized by a hidden symmetry defined by a given Killing tensor. To exhibit this hidden symmetry, the inverse metric must commute with the Killing tensor under the Schouten-Nijenhuis bracket, which translates into a system of partial differential equations (PDEs) for the inverse metric.

arxiv-2412-13743.title: User-Generated Content and Editors in Games: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2412-13743.creator: Yuyue Liu, Haihan Duan, Wei Cai
arxiv-2412-13743.description: Abstract User-Generated Content (UGC) refers to any form of content, such as posts and images, created by users rather than by professionals. In recent years, UGC has become an essential part of the evolving video game industry, influencing both game culture and community dynamics.

arxiv-2504-04710.title: TangibleNet : Synchronous Network Data Storytelling through Tangible Interactions in Augmented Reality Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26-May 1, 2025; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’25), April 26-May 1, 2025, Yokoham
arxiv-2504-04710.creator: Kentaro Takahira, Wong Kam-Kwai, Leni Yang, Xian Xu, Takanori Fujiwara, Huamin Qu
arxiv-2504-04710.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kentaro Takahira, Wong Kam-Kwai, Leni Yang, Xian Xu, Takanori Fujiwara, Huamin Qu. Synchronous data-driven storytelling with network visualizations presents significant challenges due to the complexity of real-time manipulation of network components. While existing research addresses asynchronous scenarios, there is a lack of effective tools for live presentations. To address this gap, we developed TangibleNet, a projector-based AR prototype that allows presenters to interact with node-link diagrams using double-sided magnets during live presentations.

arxiv-2507-20427.title: Model-Structured Neural Networks to Control the Steering Dynamics of Autonomous Race Cars
arxiv-2507-20427.creator: Mattia Piccinini, Aniello Mungiello, Georg Jank, Gastone Pietro Rosati Papini, Francesco Biral, Johannes Betz
arxiv-2507-20427.description: Abstract Autonomous racing has gained increasing attention in recent years, as a safe environment to accelerate the development of motion planning and control methods for autonomous driving. Deep learning models, predominantly based on neural networks (NNs), have demonstrated significant potential in modeling the vehicle dynamics and in performing various tasks in autonomous driving.

arxiv-2509-23943.title: On random bipartite graphs evolving by degrees
arxiv-2509-23943.creator: Neeladri Maitra
arxiv-2509-23943.description: Abstract In this paper, we study a bipartite analogue of the ‘random graphs evolving by degrees’ process. We are given a bipartitioned set of vertices V V into two disjoint parts ℒ \mathcal{L} and ℛ \mathcal{R} and possibly unequal positive constants α \alpha and β \beta .

arxiv-2511-15927.title: Breaking the Bottleneck with DiffuApriel: High-Throughput Diffusion LMs with Mamba Backbone
arxiv-2511-15927.creator: Vaibhav Singh Oleksiy Ostapenko Pierre-André Noël Torsten Scholak Mila – Quebec AI Institute; ServiceNow Research
arxiv-2511-15927.description: Abstract Diffusion-based language models have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, yet their reliance on Transformer backbones limits inference efficiency due to quadratic attention and KV-cache overhead. In this work, we introduce DiffuApriel , a masked diffusion language model built on a bidirectional Mamba backbone that combines the diffusion objective with linear-time sequence modeling.

arxiv-2512-13791.title: Exploring the origins of high-velocity features in SNe Ia with the spectral synthesis code tardis .
arxiv-2512-13791.creator: L. Harvey, K. Maguire, A. Holas, J. P. Anderson, T.-W. Chen, L. Galbany, S. González-Gaitán, M. Gromadzki, T. E. Müller-Bravo, G. Pignata, I. R. Seitenzahl
arxiv-2512-13791.description: Abstract Appearing as secondary higher-velocity absorption components, high-velocity features (HVFs) have been observed in several absorption lines in many Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia). The frequency and ubiquity of these components in silicon and calcium features specifically indicates that the mechanism through which they form must be common occurrence among the majority of SNe Ia.

arxiv-2602-20469.title: Numerical ranges of non-normal random matrices: elliptic Ginibre and non-Hermitian Wishart ensembles
arxiv-2602-20469.creator: Sung-Soo Byun, Joo Young Park
arxiv-2602-20469.description: Abstract . The numerical range of a non-normal matrix plays a central role as a descriptor of non-normal effects beyond spectral information. We study a class of fundamental non-Hermitian random matrix ensembles that interpolate between the Hermitian and non-Hermitian regimes. Our analysis focuses on the elliptic Ginibre ensemble and its chiral counterpart, as well as on non-Hermitian Wishart matrices.

europmc-pmc2128288.title: EPINEPHRINE CONTENT OF THE SUPRARENAL GLANDS IN ANAPHYLAXIS.
europmc-pmc2128288.creator: Smith MI, Ravitz S.
europmc-pmc2128288.description: The epinephrine store of the suprarenal glands remains unaltered in guinea pigs and rabbits which have been sensitized to ox serum, or subjected to varying degrees of anaphylactic shock by the reinjection of the foreign protein.

plos-pone-0006137.title: A Multidrug ABC Transporter with a Taste for Salt
plos-pone-0006137.creator: Saroj Velamakanni, Calvin H. F. Lau, Daniel A. P. Gutmann et al.
plos-pone-0006137.description: PLOS ONE research article. LmrA is a multidrug ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporter from Lactococcus lactis with no known physiological substrate, which can transport a wide range of chemotherapeutic agents and toxins from the cell. The protein can functionally replace the human homologue ABCB1 (also ter

pmc-10532753.title: The Potential of Endophytic Fungi for Enhancing the Growth and Accumulation of Phenolic Compounds and Anthocyanin in Maled Phai Rice (Oryza sativa L.)
pmc-10532753.creator: Thanawan Gateta, Sabaiporn Nacoon, Wasan Seemakram, Jindarat Ekprasert, Piyada Theerakulpisut, Jirawat Sanitchon, Nakarin Suwannarach, Sophon Boonlue, Cristian Atala
pmc-10532753.description: Rice (Oryza sativa L.) is one of the most popular cereal crops, being consumed by almost half of the world’s population. Among several cultivars widely distributed in Thailand, Maled Phai is a Thai pigmented-upland rice with exceptionally high nutritional value and high demand in the local Thai market.

pmc-10652480.title: Simvastatin induces pyroptosis via ROS/caspase-1/GSDMD pathway in colon cancer
pmc-10652480.creator: Wei Xie, Mingjing Peng, Ying Liu, Bocheng Zhang, Liang Yi, Ying Long
pmc-10652480.description: BackgroundThe outcome of patients with colon cancer is still unsatisfied nowadays. Simvastatin is a type of statins with anti-cancer activity, but its effect on colon cancer cells remains unclear. The present study is intended to determine the underlying mechanism of simvastatin in treatment of colon cancer.

pmc-11356631.title: Design and Fabrication of Tryptophan Sensor Using Voltammetric Method
pmc-11356631.creator: Mohd Quasim Khan, Khursheed Ahmad, Rais Ahmad Khan
pmc-11356631.description: L-tryptophan is an amino acid that significantly impacts metabolic activity in both humans and herbivorous animals. It is also known as a precursor for melatonin and serotonin, and its levels must be regulated in the human body. Therefore, there is a need to develop a cost-effective, simple, sensitive, and selective method for detecting L-tryptophan.

pmc-11643083.title: Improving the Performance of Arsenene Nanoribbon Gate-All-Around Tunnel Field-Effect Transistors Using H Defects
pmc-11643083.creator: Shun Song, Lu Qin, Zhi Wang, Juan Lyu, Jian Gong, Shenyuan Yang
pmc-11643083.description: We systematically study the transport properties of arsenene nanoribbon tunneling field-effect transistors (TFETs) along the armchair directions using first-principles calculations based on density functional theory combined with the non-equilibrium Green’s function approach. The pristine nanoribbon TFET devices with and without underlap (UL) exhibit poor performance.

pmc-12007532.title: Successful modulation of temporoparietal junction activity and stimulus-driven attention by fNIRS-based neurofeedback—A randomized controlled proof-of-concept study
pmc-12007532.creator: Simon H. Kohl, Pia Melies, Johannes Uttecht, Michael Lührs, Laura Bell, David M. A. Mehler, Surjo R. Soekadar, Shivakumar Viswanathan, Kerstin Konrad
pmc-12007532.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The right temporoparietal junction (rTPJ) is a core hub in neural networks associated with reorienting of attention and social cognition. However, it remains unknown whether participants can learn to actively modulate their rTPJ activity via neurofeedback. Here, we explored the feasibility of functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS)-based neurofeedback in modulating rTPJ activity and its effect on rTPJ functions such as reorienting of attention and visual perspective taking.

pmc-12722107.title: Effect of the rs7858836 Single‐Nucleotide Polymorphisms of the ASTN2 Gene on Pain‐Related Phenotypes in Japanese Women Who Underwent Laparoscopic Gynecologic Surgery
pmc-12722107.creator: Rie Inoue, Daisuke Nishizawa, Shoko Okahara, Atsuko Hara, Hisako Okada, Junko Hasegawa, Yuko Ebata, Kyoko Nakayama, Masakazu Hayashida, Kazutaka Ikeda
pmc-12722107.description: BackgroundIn our previous study, the minor T allele of the rs7858836 C/T single‐nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) in the ASTN2 gene, which encodes astrotactin 2, was associated with reduced fentanyl requirements after laparoscopic‐assisted colectomy and after mandibular osteotomy. In this study, we investigated the effects of this SNP on pain‐related phenotypes in patients who underwent laparoscopic gynecologic surgery (LGS).

pmc-12786862.title: Preparation of Boron Nitride Nanotube/Aluminum Matrix Composites and Their Application in Automotive Connecting Rods
pmc-12786862.creator: Yong Huang, Bingzhan Zhang, Han Zhao, Qingtao Li, Jianbo Bi
pmc-12786862.description: In order to address the urgent demand for high-performance materials in the field of automotive lightweighting, there is a need for solutions to the interface instability and performance degradation of traditional reinforcing phases (e.g., SiC, CNT) at elevated temperatures. The present study prepared BNNTs/Al composites via the stirred casting method for automotive connecting rods.

pmc-13137559.title: Multilocus genome-wide association study reveals genomic regions associated with resistance to red leaf blotch in soybean
pmc-13137559.creator: Yechalew Sileshi, Kassahun Bantte, Abush Tesfaye, Harun Murithi
pmc-13137559.description: Soybean [Glycine max (L.) Merr.] is a widely grown crop used for food, feed, and industrial purposes. However, a fungal disease known as Red Leaf Blotch (RLB), poses a significant threat to soybean production, and developing resistant varieties is a key management strategy.

pmc-13380043.title: An Evidence-Based Framework for Patient-Facing Artificial Intelligence Integration in the Emergency Department
pmc-13380043.creator: Tehreem Rehman, Philip Jarrett, Joshua Lesko, James Augustine, Bradley D Shy, Rohit B Sangal, Nicholas Genes, Donald U Apakama, Ethan E Abbott, Abhi Mehrotra, Richard Andrew Taylor
pmc-13380043.description: The emergency department is a high-need setting for patient-facing artificial intelligence (PF-AI) because it functions as both a health care safety net and, increasingly, a digital front door for unscheduled acute care. We define PF-AI as tools that interact directly with patients to collect information, deliver tailored communication, and support decision making under clinician governance.
